description: This file defines two interfaces, IStuckGrain and IStuckCleanGrain, for Orleans grain contracts used in unit testing. It includes method signatures for grain behaviors such as running indefinitely, non-blocking calls, and activation status checks.

classes.name: IStuckGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that can run indefinitely, handle non-blocking calls, and report its activation status.

classes.name: IStuckCleanGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that can release resources and check if it is activated, identified by a Guid.

methods.name: RunForever
methods.description: Starts the grain's infinite execution loop.

methods.name: GetNonBlockingCallCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of non-blocking calls made.

methods.name: DidActivationTryToStart
methods.description: Checks whether the grain attempted to activate with the given GrainId.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the grain resource associated with the specified Guid.

methods.name: IsActivated
methods.description: Checks if the grain with the given Guid is currently activated.
